exposure: conservative surgical treatment (hysteroscopic excision of lesion)
cohort: A young woman diagnosed with Grade 1a, Stage 1 endometrial cancer who was experiencing infertility and desired to preserve her fertility.
finding: Conservative surgical treatment of early-stage endometrial cancer followed by in-vitro fertilization (IVF) is a feasible alternative for young women who desire to preserve their fertility, potentially reducing treatment duration compared to conventional hormonal therapy.
mod_finding: The patient delivered a male baby via cesarean section.
